content:
emma: prototyping a 'shadow snapshot' flow to run config bundles (flags + routing + quotas) against sampled live traffic without changing routing. aim: catch policy / decision regressions pre-rollout. thoughts?

ryan: sounds great. snapshot should be an immutable artifact with id + signature so private deploys can verify.

priya: API idea: POST /snapshots {bundle, sample:{pct:5}, mode:"shadow"} -> {snapshot_id, estimated_ops, signature}. runtime can accept signed only in Private.

lin: console UX: "Run shadow" button, choose pct or route filter, duration, and show estimated cost. preview mismatches side-by-side.

carl: important: shadow evals mustn't count against customer quotas. track metrics separately: shadow.eval_count, shadow.decision_diff_pct.

emma: safety: auto-block promotion if snapshot.regression_detected > 1% for 15m. also allow cancel from SRE.

infra-bot: shadow-run 6098765432 started by emma: sample=2%, duration=20m, id=snap-2026-03-21-02.

priya: tests: nightly regression that replays staging traffic with snapshot and asserts zero decision drift for golden cases.

lin: rollout: internal beta -> hosted opt-in -> gated private with signed snapshots + SRE runbook.

emma: PR created (#4201). please review; if no objections I'll kick the canary tomorrow.

deploy-bot: CI: checks passed for #4201, staging deploy queued.
